headline: Delaware court blocks Verisk’s exit from $2.35 billion AccuLynx deal
summary: Investing.com -- A Delaware judge has ordered Verisk Analytics to attempt to complete its proposed $2.35 billion acquisition of roofing software provider AccuLynx, Reuters reported on Friday, more than seven months after Verisk terminated the transaction.
